title: ywec.e: secure datagram sender identity from routable source (secure.rs:1933, rpl_stack/secure.rs:143)
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-ywec. secure.rs:1933 derives sender_iid = header.src.0[8..] for ReceivedSecureDatagram - wrong when src is a routable AddrForKey /128 (that 8-byte tail is not the link-auth SHA-512 IID used as peer key). Downstream rpl_stack/secure.rs:143 peer_matches_destination = dst.0[8..] == peer_iid is likewise dead for routable response destinations. Fix: when the address is link-local keep IID correlation (valid); when routable, correlate via full ygg_addr_from_pubkey(peer pubkey from link layer). Check all consumers of ReceivedSecureDatagram.sender_iid before changing the field semantics.
